cuts.head: tilt
cuts.ofreeRecent: a riverside pavilion tower over the Yangtze — standing; a small present-day neighborhood outdoor cinema before the screening — she settles into a canvas chair and peels a mandarin for her own snack; a private orbital hotel room with a soft amber bedside reading light and an opaque shuttered window — After a nap she sits up and stretches her legs forward; an empty indoor wave-pool spectator bench after swimming — She shakes trapped water from a removable silicone swimming cap; a present-day public riverside chess terrace on a bright autumn afternoon — she solves a chess endgame on her own; a museum hands-on workshop table before opening — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a rocky coast path with tide pools — standing; a modern rooftop vegetable garden with a shaded dining alcove — She gives a ripe peach a careful first bite while watching the city; a misty enchanted garden of moss — holds a small bouquet at chest height; a starship galley and mess hall — holds a towel folded against her chest; a snowy mountain-lodge terrace with a wooden railing and benches above a winter valley — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a Guan Yu temple — holds a cup in both hands; a wooden river dock above calm water — standing
